epochs.metric: validation force MAE, EMA weights, all validation structures (kcal/mol/A)

sae.method: atomic reference energies by least squares: E0(Z) = E0_foundation(Z) + lstsq(counts, E_fit - E_foundation) on the training structures (<= 40,000, all structures with a rare element kept) — the formula of mace.data.estimate_e0s_from_foundation (MACE --E0s=estimated); MACE --E0s=average (verified in mace/data/utils.compute_average_E0s: lstsq of total energies on atom counts) would double count the foundation's interaction energy because load_foundations_elements copies the foundation scale/shift. AIMNet2: the same residual least squares with the pretrained atomic shifts zeroed (= aimnet SAE, mode linreg).

hyper.scheduler: ReduceLROnPlateau factor 0.8 patience 10 threshold 0.0 rel (strictly lower = the best / early-stop rule) on val force MAE (EMA), from epoch 3
hyper.grad_skip: non-finite gradient with finite loss: step skipped; STOP at 10 in a row or 100 in one epoch
hyper.stop: lr < 1e-06 | 100 epochs without improvement | 1000 epochs | 150.0 GPU-h

decisions.FTF-scope: user 11-05 20:5x step 1: the FT-cap train / valid caps are removed; every structure that passes the finetune.Pool filters (level label, finite, even electron count, fmax <= 10 eV/A, exact-duplicate dedupe FT-dedupe, D0 holdout FT-d0hold, truncated Nurion systems FT-leak-trunc) is used. The pilot / capped models are not retrained; their split files and models are not touched.
decisions.FTF-split: membership = finetune.build_split unchanged (drop by tags OR targets(); validation = whole fold_core groups in a seeded order until >= 10 % of the remaining D1 reactions, + Nurion non-target rows of those cores; test = dropped structures whose rxn_ids are all held out) with caps train 0 / valid 0 (no cap) / test 20,000 (FT-cap tier rule and seed). Validation is NOT capped: the existing validation logic has no size limit besides FT-cap (FT_all_s0 had 81,569 validation structures before the cap, fold 4 41,739). Seeds = the capped runs' (valid SEED+100+k / +200+i / +300+d; cap SEED+1000+same), so FT_<k>_full holds out exactly fold k as FT_<k>. Index files = sorted int32 store row ids.
decisions.FTF-g4: G-4 (kind al_ts, $MLT/dft/gen_G4.extxyz) is included iff the file exists and results/G4_report.json says complete at data-build time (finetune with_al rules: G4 read last, dedupe after the base inputs, hold_al, tier 1); otherwise 'G-4 not used' is recorded. A running training keeps its pinned split.
decisions.FTF-train: AIMNet2 as finetune.train_aimnet: released aimnet2_wb97m_d3_0 weights (parity check vs the yaml build), atomic shifts zeroed, NaN species rows of afv -> 0, D3 head = B3LYP-D3(BJ) (s8 1.9889, a1 0.3981, a2 4.4211), molecular charge input, E0 (SAE) by least squares on <= 40,000 training structures (all with a rare element), MTLoss energy_loss_fn (ew 1) + peratom_loss_fn forces (fw), RAdam wd 1e-8 (shifts 0), batch 64, torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_value_ 0.4 (the existing value: element-wise value clipping, not norm). Loader: per epoch the shards in a seeded order (rng [train_seed, epoch]); a shard's training rows are gathered from the memory-mapped .npy files (next shard prefetched in a thread), sorted by atom count after a seeded shuffle, cut into batches of <= 64 (padding to the batch maximum, numbers 0 = padding as aimnet merge_groups), batch order shuffled. Validation rows are gathered once (exact-size batches of 128, as before).
decisions.FTF-ema: weight EMA 0.99 updated after every optimizer step (all parameters incl. shifts; torch._foreach_lerp_); validation and the exported model use the EMA weights; best_ema.pt = EMA weights of the best epoch.
decisions.FTF-sched: metric = validation force MAE over all validation structures (kcal/mol/A, mean |dF| over Cartesian components of real atoms) with EMA weights; it drives ReduceLROnPlateau (factor 0.8, patience 10, threshold 0 rel = strictly lower), best-checkpoint selection (strictly lower) and early stopping, so all three share one improvement definition. Validation energy MAE (training frame, kcal/mol) and TS-near force MAE are recorded only. Warmup: epochs 0-2, lr linear per optimizer step 1e-5 -> 1e-4; the plateau scheduler steps from epoch 3 on.
decisions.FTF-stop: stop when lr < 1e-6 after a scheduler step, or 100 epochs without a better validation force MAE, or 1,000 epochs, or the GPU-h cap; then export the best EMA weights (stop.json keeps the reason so a resubmit goes straight to export).
decisions.FTF-budget: GPU-h = wall-h of the train command (finetune.Budget, budget.json, summed over attempts). For *_full runs the 12 h target / 24 GPU-h STOP of FT-budget is replaced by a 150 GPU-h cap (user 11-05 20:5x): no epoch is started when it would end past 150 GPU-h, and a cap reached mid-epoch drops that epoch; both are a normal stop (export, exit 0), not exit 3.
decisions.FTF-fw: force weight: --fw if given; else the lead's $MLT/pipeline/ft_abl_choice.json ('fw', or 'choice' -> baseline 0.2 / fw1 1.0 / fw5 5.0); else PIPELINE_STATE.json params ft_abl_choice / ft_train_args (when ft_abl_cand is AIMNet2); else 1.0 (no FT-abl decision). The value is pinned in run_key.json at the first start; a later decision is recorded but does not change a started run (restart = --force).
decisions.FTF-resume: checkpoint every epoch (last.pt: model, EMA, optimizer, scheduler, epoch, optimizer step, best metric / epoch, the best EMA weights themselves, history; atomic; best_ema.pt is rewritten from that copy after last.pt, and again right before export, so weights and recorded best epoch always agree). lock.json is released on every exit. A resubmit resumes; the run key (split fingerprint, store, lr, ew, fw, batch, EMA) is pinned, a different key = STOP (--force moves the run dir aside, never deletes). The trainer pauses (exit 2) when the next epoch would end past --wall-h of this job.
decisions.FTF-selfcheck: at every start: split meta (C-2 pass, inputs complete, store fingerprint), index overlap, the first training shard (atom count, elements, finite arrays), one training batch forward + backward (finite loss and gradients, no optimizer step) and one validation batch with the EMA model (finite energies / forces); any failure = STOP (exit 3) before the E0 fit and training.
